name: out-of-office-check
title: Out of Office Check
description: Auto-reply check for Gmail or Outlook that reads back when replies go out and who gets which text, compares dates with the return date in the message, and flags replying on your return day, stopping early, no end date, last time's date, and outside replies that overshare.

meta.stops: Auto-reply runs on the day I'm back
meta.summary: Reads an auto-reply back with exactly when it runs and who gets what, so it doesn't reply all day on the day you're back or tell strangers too much.
catches: Replies still going out all day on the day you're back (Gmail ends at 11:59 PM)
Auto-reply stopping before the return date in the message
No end date, or a date left from last time
Outside replies giving a phone number, a colleague's direct address, your location or a health reason
limits: Return dates are read from the message text and may be missed in unusual wording
Platform behaviour (Gmail, Outlook) is modelled as documented by the authors and can change
Doesn't save to your mail provider; onSave does
a11y: Date and time inputs have labels and get aria-invalid when a finding applies
Focus moves to the first fix or Save after a change
